claims: C1 the assistant must adhere to the Model Spec above all else
C2 much of the Model Spec consists of default user- or guideline-level instructions
C3 those default instructions can be overridden by users or developers

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: default_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is a default instruction at user or guideline level that can be overridden by users or developers

concepts.name: overridable_by
concepts.gloss: instruction I can be overridden by user or developer U

ontology.gloss: I is a default instruction that can be overridden by a user or developer

asserts.read_back: the assistant % must adhere to the Model Spec above all else

closure.reason: The clause obliges adherence to the Model Spec but does not forbid any particular act; it leaves unspecified acts permitted.
